pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 20 °C·d above 2 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)130 °C·d$(). Best near 20 °C; stops above 34 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -6 °C (-5 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5.5-7.5 (tolerates 4.5-8.5). Roots 0.3 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 25, P 5, K 35 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 54 cwt/ac (6 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Radish and Radish Seeds.
